text: 这批货是从比利时运来的。
name: 比利

text: 他去过圣彼得堡，还在那儿冻掉了两个脚趾。
name: 彼得

text: May I come in? It's hot out there.
name: May

text: Mark the spot on the map before you leave.
name: Mark

text: Bill the county for the damages and send the receipt to Austin.
name: Bill

text: 她从口袋里掏出一张拉斯维加斯赌场的筹码。
name: 拉斯

text: 他把车开进大卫营附近的检查站，哨兵挥手让他停下。
name: 大卫

text: Grace under pressure, that was the sheriff's motto.
name: Grace

text: 比利把十字架往桌上一放，盯着你看。
name: 比利

text: May said she'd be back by sundown.
name: May

text: 彼得在圣诞聚会上喝醉了，却坚持要开车。
name: 彼得

text: Ask Bill about the truck; he towed it in last week.
name: Bill

text: 拉索擦了擦手，朝加油机走过去。
name: 拉索

text: Mark Harris was last seen at the motel.
name: Mark

text: 她叫海伦，在杂货店后头算账。
name: 海伦
